articles.title: Peptide Signaling and Receptor Discovery: A Conversation with James Checco
articles.description: In this interview, James Checco shares his path into chemical biology, how his lab studies peptide-receptor interactions and D-amino acid-containing peptides, and his approach to mentoring independent researchers.

articles.title: Optimizing Temperature, Time, and Kinetics in Research-Scale SPPS
articles.description: How temperature and coupling time influence reaction kinetics, side reactions, and crude purity in research-scale peptide synthesis. Explore model peptide results, coupling chemistries, and the role of solvent preheating.

articles.title: Scaling Up SPPS: Choosing the Right Thermal Technology
articles.description: How temperature control affects crude purity, yield, and process consistency as peptide synthesis moves from research to pilot and commercial scale. Explore conduction, microwave, and induction heating, solvent pre-heating, and real-time temperature feedback.

articles.title: Quarterly Update - Q2 2026 Peptide News
articles.description: The second quarter of 2026 has been a bustling period for peptide drug development, with continued growth in obesity and metabolic health and new developments in oncology and pain management. We’ve highlighted advancements spanning Phase 2/3 data in chronic weight management as well as targeted peptide treatments tackling oncology, rare bone disorders, and chronic inflammation.

articles.title: How to Choose a Peptide Synthesizer
articles.description: A practical CSBio selection guide for choosing the right automated peptide synthesizer for research, process development, pilot production, GMP manufacturing, and commercial scale peptide production.

articles.title: Quarterly Update - Q1 2026 Peptide News
articles.description: The start of 2026 has shown that the "Peptide Renaissance" is only accelerating. From the landmark approval of the first oral peptide for psoriasis to the massive expansion of the GLP-1 landscape, synthetic peptides continue to move from niche biologics to front-line primary care.

articles.title: Modernizing SPPS for Better CMC Outcomes
articles.description: Recorded live at TIDES Europe, the leading international conference for peptides, CSBio’s Hanson Chang was invited to showcase the latest solid-phase peptide synthesis technologies to improve CMC outcomes—boosting yield and control while reducing solvent use. The talk highlights practical, scalable approaches to process development and tech transfer in peptide manufacturing.
